profile:
### Lilac Breezie — G4

Lilac Breezie is a tiny, fairy-like Breezie best recognized as **Hasbro’s pink-and-purple 2014 collectible figure**, not as a named television character. Her large butterfly wings and curled antennae make her easy to pick out.

- **Appearance:** Bright pink/magenta body, wavy purple mane and tail, pale-yellow curled antennae, green eyes, and enormous turquoise wings patterned with dark-purple swirls.
- **Name and history:** **Lilac Breezie** is an **official Hasbro merchandise name**, printed on her collector card—not a fan-given name. She was **#24 (bag code AZ)** in **Wave 11 (2014)**, alongside Cloudia Breezie and Sunny Breezie, and was also issued in the UK’s Wave 11B. Her card says she and her friends love visiting Ponyville. See the [contemporary Wave 11 card-and-code report](https://www.mlpmerch.com/2014/08/mlp-wave-11-blind-bag-codes-wave-11.html).
- **Appearances and voice:** Breezies feature in *Friendship Is Magic* S4E16, [“It Ain’t Easy Being Breezies” (official episode)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hjWuxTpOct4), but **Lilac Breezie has no verified individual on-screen identification, spoken lines, or credited voice actor**. A shared Breezie design does not prove that a particular background figure is her; see the [character reference](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_non-pony_characters/Breezies). No distinct film or comic appearance is verified.
